# edgeos_firewall_settings (Resource)

The global firewall options directly below `firewall`, such as `all-ping`, `syn-cookies` and `source-validation`. These are kernel network settings that apply to the whole router. There is only one set per router, so the resource takes over the existing values on create and the ID is always `firewall`.

Only the attributes you set are managed. Attributes left unset are neither read nor changed, and removing an attribute from the configuration deletes the leaf, so EdgeOS uses its default again. Import reads every attribute. Rule sets (`firewall name`, `firewall ipv6-name`, `firewall modify`), groups and `firewall options` are never touched; manage rule sets with `edgeos_firewall_name` and `edgeos_firewall_rule`.

Destroying the resource writes the EdgeOS defaults back for every managed option: `all-ping`, `log-martians`, `send-redirects` and `syn-cookies` enabled, the rest disabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_firewall_settings" "this" {
  all_ping               = true
  broadcast_ping         = false
  ip_src_route           = false
  ipv6_receive_redirects = false
  ipv6_src_route         = false
  log_martians           = true
  receive_redirects      = false
  send_redirects         = true
  source_validation      = "disable"
  syn_cookies            = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all_ping` (Boolean) Answer ICMP echo requests sent to the router (`all-ping enable`). EdgeOS default: `true`.
- `broadcast_ping` (Boolean) Answer ICMP echo requests sent to a broadcast address (`broadcast-ping enable`). EdgeOS default: `false`.
- `ip_src_route` (Boolean) Accept IPv4 packets with the source route option (`ip-src-route enable`). EdgeOS default: `false`.
- `ipv6_receive_redirects` (Boolean) Accept ICMPv6 redirects (`ipv6-receive-redirects enable`). EdgeOS default: `false`.
- `ipv6_src_route` (Boolean) Accept IPv6 packets with a routing header (`ipv6-src-route enable`). EdgeOS default: `false`.
- `log_martians` (Boolean) Log IPv4 packets with impossible source addresses (`log-martians enable`). EdgeOS default: `true`.
- `receive_redirects` (Boolean) Accept ICMP redirects (`receive-redirects enable`). EdgeOS default: `false`.
- `send_redirects` (Boolean) Send ICMP redirects (`send-redirects enable`). EdgeOS default: `true`.
- `source_validation` (String) Reverse path filtering for IPv4 (`source-validation`): `disable`, `strict` (drop packets that would not be routed back out of the interface they came in on) or `loose` (drop packets whose source is not reachable at all). EdgeOS default: `disable`.
- `syn_cookies` (Boolean) Use TCP SYN cookies against SYN floods (`syn-cookies enable`). EdgeOS default: `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `firewall`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_firewall_settings.this
  id = "firewall"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_firewall_settings.example 'firewall'
```
